mission.mission_statement: Riverbend Community Health Alliance brings preventive care, dental services and mental health support to rural families in north-central Washington, regardless of ability to pay.
mission.vision_statement: Every rural family in the Columbia River valley can see a clinician within a day.
values: Care regardless of ability to pay

programs.name: Mobile Dental Clinic
programs.description: Two mobile units provide cleanings, sealants and restorative care at schools and farmworker housing.

programs.name: Community Health Worker Network
programs.description: Bilingual community health workers connect families to primary and behavioral health care.
